chapters.label: Thunderbolt
chapters.text: Wembley, 1966, World Cup. England against Mexico. Bobby Charlton, in white, picks it up in his own half. Straight down the middle, jinks left, jinks right... boom! A thunderbolt into the top corner!

chapters.label: Left, then right
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Left, then right, opening a gap. Then his right foot hits it from twenty-five yards!

chapters.label: Either foot
chapters.text: The keeper can't reach it! Charlton could strike like that with either foot.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: practise shooting with both feet, so you can shoot whichever way the ball comes!
